description.value:
You fire a beam of energy, acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic, your choice, at a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged tech attack; on a hit, the target takes 1d8 damage of the chosen type.

This power's damage rises to 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th level, and 4d8 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
